newPlatforms.name: KZYX One-Selection Digital and Physical Music Submission Route
newPlatforms.country: United States / Mendocino County, California community radio with international eligibility not explicitly stated

authorizedRoute.routeType: first-party public Music Department mailbox for one streaming link or WAV musical selection, with an optional vinyl/CD alternative
authorizedRoute.contactPublication: The official How to Submit Music page publishes music@kzyx.org in plaintext and directs one musical selection to that mailbox. The official staff page identifies Katharine Cole as Music Director.
authorizedRoute.explicitPurpose: Music submission for possible KZYX airplay.
authorizedRoute.permittedAutomatedScope: discovery, passive verification, enrichment, deduplication and queueing only
authorizedRoute.safeHumanAction: Reopen the official page, select one suitable MarcsMusic track, identify relevant KZYX programmes, use either one streaming link or a manually confirmed compliant WAV file, and send one reviewed email manually.

publishedRequirements: forward one musical selection by email to music@kzyx.org
use either a streaming link or WAV file
use the subject format MUSIC SUBMISSION/*DJ or show name and/or genre
include website, social-media or Linktree information
include radio-promotion company or label information when applicable
review KZYX's schedule and suggest relevant programmers or shows
KZYX responds for more information only when interested
vinyl and CDs may alternatively be mailed to the Music Director
no account login, CAPTCHA or mandatory payment is published
safeReviewScope: select exactly one MarcsMusic track with clear programme fit
identify only genuinely relevant DJs or shows from the current KZYX schedule
prefer a permissioned streaming link unless KZYX confirms the exact WAV specification
confirm the streaming link is accessible without login, expiry or password barriers
verify release date, artist links, contact details and short description
confirm whether international artists are eligible because the page does not state a territory rule
confirm current explicit-content and clean-edit expectations
confirm the current AI-assisted or AI-generated music policy
confirm ownership and permission for all submitted material
choose digital or physical delivery rather than sending both by default
retain needs_manual_review until all content and eligibility checks are complete
unresolvedEligibility: whether singles, EPs, albums and previously released tracks are treated differently
the intended meaning of the published WAV wording 'ADPCM or ACM 44.1KB, 16-bit stereo WAV'
maximum attachment size if a WAV file is used
whether downloadable files are preferred over non-downloadable streams

emails.verification: first-party plaintext publication, explicit submission purpose, valid syntax and exact kzyx.org domain alignment

businessContact.emailStatus: one source-verified public Music Department mailbox stored
businessContact.verification: The mailbox is published in plaintext on KZYX's official submission page and is explicitly assigned to music submissions. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed, and no message was sent.

formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: The canonical route is a public Music Department email requiring a human-selected track, programme routing and final review of unresolved international, content, WAV-format and AI-origin rules.
adjacentRoutesExcluded: general contact and staff mailboxes as substitutes for music@kzyx.org
individual programmer outreach without a genuine show fit
third-party directories and copied contact details

activityVerification.evidence: KZYX's first-party site displayed a live-radio interface, current programme and playlist surfaces, a July 9, 2026 newsletter, an August 30, 2026 KZYX Summer Music Festival notice, a current staff page and 2026 copyright notices.

genreFitEvidence: KZYX's submission page states that its programmers cover genres including Reggae, EDM, Latinx, Groove, Alternative, Rock, Jazz and other formats.
The current programme directory includes World Tour, Heavyweight Sounds, DJ Filthy D's Dance Therapy, FutuRetro, Alma Latina, Redwood Soul Shakedown and other broad music shows.
Selected MarcsMusic electronic, reggae, world-fusion, bass, dance or cross-genre material has plausible fit after exact track-to-show matching.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: KZYX provides a legitimate free-first public Music Department email route for one musical selection and an authorized physical alternative. A human must select one track, identify appropriate programmes, clarify the unusual published WAV wording, confirm international eligibility, content and AI-origin rules, and manually send one reviewed submission.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: Repository code search and the full open pull-request patch were checked before creation for KZYX, kzyx.org, music@kzyx.org and the canonical submission path; no existing music-submission-agent platform, seed or queue record was found.
deduplication.consolidation: The digital email route and optional physical-media route are stored as one canonical KZYX opportunity. General contacts, individual hosts, donations, membership, underwriting, PSA, community-calendar and third-party-directory routes are excluded.

notes: One new KZYX community-radio opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. The official route accepts one musical selection through a verified public Music Department mailbox using a streaming link or WAV file, with optional physical delivery. No submission was made.
